rounds.text: Karnavati Finance Ltd is currently demonstrating an aggressive expansion phase, evidenced by a remarkable 238% compounded sales growth over the trailing twelve months [E16]. This recent surge is not an isolated event but rather the culmination of a long-term trend, as the company has maintained consistent compounded sales growth of 28% over the last decade [E13], 34% over five years [E14], and 23% over three years [E15]. These figures significantly outperform the sector median sales growth of 16.5% [E55], suggesting the company is capturing market share at an accelerating pace. While the market currently prices the stock at a premium book value of 3.39x compared to the sector benchmark of 1.35x [E6], this valuation reflects the market's recognition of the company's superior top-line momentum. Conceded: [E3], [E4], [E5], [E7], [E8], [E17], [E18], [E19], [E20], [E21], [E42], [E49]. The disconnect between the company's rapid sales expansion and its current share price performance indicates that the market has yet to fully price in the long-term value of this sustained revenue growth [E13, E14, E15, E16].
